caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sled viewed from above, with a curved front and parallel metal runners on each side. The runners are outlined in rust-brown color with visible attachment bolts. The main surface of the sled is decorated with an illustration featuring a seated woman in a blue-green dress, brown hair, and a green background with some ground details. Above the woman, text reads "F.J. PLUMMER" in large brown letters, while below her it says "HAVERHILL", "JANUARY 1," and the year "1844" in prominent brown numerals. Further below there is a star shape, and the text "Nashua Log Co." is visible in an arc at the rounded tip of the sled. The surface of the sled shows visible signs of aging, such as cracks and worn paint. The drawing is centered on a plain light beige background.
title: Sled
